title: Consume the per-column sortability signal: no sort affordance on columns the platform declares unsortable — downstream leg of objectstack#10235's ruling
body:
Filed by the triage seat as the ruled consumer leg of objectstack-ai/objectstack#10235 (maintainer 2026-08-23, ruling A: the platform serves an explicit per-column sortability signal; the grid reads it and never re-derives "virtual ⇒ unsortable" from field type).

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#10235

## Scope (after the upstream signal lands and the spec pin covers it)

1. Grid/table headers drop the sort affordance on any column the served metadata marks unsortable — the click ceases to exist, so neither the silent-unordered behavior (today) nor the 422 refusal (post-#9313) is reachable from the UI.
2. The personalization PUT is never issued for such a column.
3. ⛔ No local "formula ⇒ unsortable" fallback derivation — if the signal is absent on the pinned spec version, this card is not ready (that is what the `Blocked-by:` is for), not a license to shadow-derive.

Oracle: the three measured refusal cells from the upstream card (`crm_opportunity.expected_revenue` ×2 views, `showcase_project.budget_remaining`) must become unofferable clicks; a sortable control column on the same grids keeps its affordance (both directions pinned).

Refs: objectstack-ai/objectstack#10235 (ruling + spec leg) · objectstack#9313 / PR #10234 (the widening that makes today's click loud).
